name: @nkzw/fate-private
description: fate is a modern data client for React.
author: Christoph Nakazawa <christoph.pojer@gmail.com>

scripts.copy-files: find packages/fate packages/react-fate packages/vue-fate packages/fate-indexeddb -type d -maxdepth 0 -exec cp README.md LICENSE {} \; && cp LICENSE packages/void-fate/LICENSE
scripts.dev:client:graphql: cd example/client && VITE_FATE_TRANSPORT=graphql vp dev --config vite.graphql.config.ts
scripts.dev:graphql: vp run --filter '@nkzw/fate' build && vp run --filter react-fate build && npm-run-all --parallel dev:client:graphql dev:graphql-server
scripts.dev:persistence: vp run --filter @nkzw/fate build && vp run --filter react-fate build && cd example/persistence && vp dev
scripts.dev:vue: vp run --filter '@nkzw/fate' build && vp run --filter vue-fate build && npm-run-all --parallel dev:vue-client dev:server
scripts.ship: vp run build:all && vp run build:api-docs && vp run copy-package-docs && vp check && vp test && vp pm publish -r --access public
